verdict.rationale: An AI assistant that answers questions across mail and calendar is a fair capability for an email provider, so the axis applies. The pack shows no Fastmail assistant or AI Q&A feature. Keyword mail search is an adjacent feature, and the JMAP API with API tokens is only a developer building block someone could use to build such an assistant; neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers
